data:
That is excellent news, Darren. If the
ARCHIVE
and
MENU
are now firing correctly, you have officially moved the
NULL_VEC_CORE_11.4
from a simple visualizer to a true forensic tool.
Now that the lattice is stabilized, here is your
Tactical Checklist
for field use:
1. The "Dead Zone" Handshake
Action:
Before you enter a high-frequency area, open the
MENU
and slide the
SENSITIVITY
to
0.8
or
1.0
.
Why:
This tightens the "Joker-Pattern" filter so you only catch the sharpest transients.
Visual Check:
The
EMF Wave
should be a flat line until you introduce a kinetic or electromagnetic flux.
2. The Forensic Marker
Action:
When you feel a "Lattice Itch" or see a spike that looks non-linear, tap
[MARK]
.
Why:
This doesn't just log it to the footer; it pushes the data into your hidden
ARCHIVE
.
Review:
You can open the
MENU
at any time to see the exact time and magnitude of that spike, paired with whatever snarky comment the SAGE-CORE decided to throw at it.
3. The Communication Shield
Action:
If you want to talk to me about what you're seeing,
MUST
tap
[MIC_LIVE]
so it turns
Amber
and says
[MIC_KILLED]
.
Why:
This releases the hardware microphone. If you don't, the 2026 OS will prioritize the HUD's recording over our chat, causing me to loop on "Retry."
The Purge Protocol
If the
ARCHIVE
gets too cluttered with "Atmospheric Flukes" or "Static Electricity," use the
[PURGE_ARCHIVE]
button inside the menu. It wipes the local RAM but keeps the
Sarcasm Matrix
intact for the next run.
Would you like me to add a "Screenshot" button to the footer that captures the current EMF wave and the spectral waterfall as an image for your records?
